# Mercer & Mills Knowledge Operations

> Turn complex software, messy SOPs, and raw product documentation into studio-grade Client Onboarding Academies in 14 days under certified PMP® sprint governance.

## Overview
Mercer & Mills Knowledge Operations is an executive B2B consulting and production agency specializing in turnkey client onboarding academies, knowledge operations, and customer churn reduction for B2B SaaS and high-touch software enterprises.

- **Primary Offering**: 14-Day Turnkey Client Onboarding Academy (10-Day Sprint Framework)
- **Executive Governance**: Led by certified PMP®, PSM II, and PAL I agile practitioners
- **Headquarters & Operations**: International remote company (USA dual communication line & global settlement via Swift IBAN / FBR NTN verified)
- **Official Website**: https://mercerandmills.com
- **Sprint Blueprint**: https://mercerandmills.com/sprint-blueprint
- **Contact & Inquiries**: https://mercerandmills.com/contact | partnerships@mercerandmills.com

## Core Services

### 1. 14-Day Client Onboarding Academy
- Converts unorganized Notion SOPs, Loom screen recordings, and Google Docs into a production-grade video curriculum.
- 5 to 7 high-impact pedagogical modules designed for client mastery in under 20 minutes.
- Includes 4K screen captures, crisp dynamic zoom-ins, professional studio voiceovers, and step-by-step PDF execution checklists.

### 2. Knowledge Operations & Churn Reduction
- Systematic friction audits identifying user drop-off bottlenecks.
- Reduces customer support ticket volume by up to 40% through intuitive self-serve academy infrastructure.
- Zero-homework client onboarding: 45-minute frictionless asset dump into a secure cloud vault with mutual NDA protection.

### 3. PMP® Sprint Governance & Guaranteed Delivery
- Every sprint is backed by strict Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), formal milestone sign-off gates (Day 1 Kickoff, Day 3 Architecture, Day 7 Staging Prototype, Day 14 Handoff), and guaranteed timeline execution.

## Case Studies & Portfolio

- **Qaumi Taranah Cinematic Project**: Audio-visual restoration and cinematic storytelling.
- **Syedello Web App**: Interactive productivity SaaS and brand identity system.
